description: A map with markers and lines. Tiles come from `tileUrlTemplate`, fetched over HTTPS from a domain the plugin declares (SEC-080); the Google package ignores the template and uses the host's API key. Showing the user's location needs the `location` device API and its permission. Each marker is a semantics node with its title.

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What the map shows, spoken before its markers.

props.name: tileUrlTemplate
props.description: The tile URL with `{z}`, `{x}` and `{y}`; HTTPS on a declared domain. Without it no tiles are drawn.

props.name: attribution
props.description: The tile provider's attribution, always shown; required when `tileUrlTemplate` is set.

props.name: showUserLocation
props.description: Show the user's position; needs the `location` device API.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Whether the user can pan and zoom.

events.name: onMarkerTap
events.description: A marker was tapped; the payload is its `id`.

events.name: onMapTap
events.description: The map was tapped away from a marker; the payload is the position.

events.name: onCameraIdle
events.description: The camera stopped moving; the payload is its centre and zoom.
